methods.detail: If x<0 minX+=x else maxX+=x, same for y,z. Returns new box. Predicts occupied volume before axis-separated clipping.
methods.name: addCoord
methods.purpose: Sweeps box along motion vector for collision broadphase.

methods.detail: min-=x and max+=x per axis. Negative input shrinks. Used for entity search radii and render culling inflation.
methods.name: expand
methods.purpose: Grows box symmetrically on all sides.

methods.detail: min+=x and max-=x per axis. Used to test sneaking and suffocation with smaller footprint. Returns new box.
methods.name: contract
methods.purpose: Shrinks box symmetrically for stuck checks.

methods.detail: Requires other.maxY>minY etc. If offsetX>0 uses minX-other.maxX, if <0 uses maxX-other.minX. Keeps closer-to-zero value.
methods.name: calculateXOffset
methods.purpose: Clips X motion against this box if YZ overlap.

methods.detail: Same pattern on XZ overlap. Positive uses minY-other.maxY, negative uses maxY-other.minY. Core of gravity and step logic.
methods.name: calculateYOffset
methods.purpose: Clips Y motion, handles landing and ceilings.

methods.detail: Mirrors X/Y logic on Z axis. Prevents tunneling through walls. Chained with X and Y passes in moveEntity.
methods.name: calculateZOffset
methods.purpose: Clips Z motion if XY overlap.

methods.detail: Uses > and < so touching faces do not count. Short-circuit ternary chain. Used for entity-entity and block push checks.
methods.name: intersectsWith
methods.purpose: Tests strict overlap on all three axes.

methods.detail: Computes intermediate points per face, discards via isVecInYZ/XZ/XY, picks nearest by squareDistanceTo. Returns MovingObjectPosition with EnumFacing.
methods.name: calculateIntercept
methods.purpose: Ray-traces segment against six box planes.

AxisAlignedBB.overview: Immutable double collision box in net.minecraft.util with min/max corners. Used by Entity.moveEntity for collision clipping and ray traces. Matters for movement because server validates player positions against contracted and offset boxes.

internal_fields.name: NUM_X_BITS
internal_fields.role: 26 bits for X derived from 30M world border

internal_fields.name: X_SHIFT
internal_fields.role: Bit shift for X field in packed long

internal_fields.name: Y_SHIFT
internal_fields.role: Bit shift for Y field in packed long

methods.detail: Layout X 26 bits shifted X_SHIFT, Y 12 bits shifted Y_SHIFT, Z 26 bits. Masks with X_MASK/Y_MASK/Z_MASK. Written by PacketBuffer.writeBlockPos.
methods.name: toLong
methods.purpose: Packs x,y,z into one 64-bit long for wire.

methods.detail: Sign-extending shifts: (serialized<<(64-shift-bits))>>(64-bits). Reconstructs negative coords correctly. Read path for block packets.
methods.name: fromLong
methods.purpose: Unpacks long back into signed x,y,z.

methods.detail: Adds facing offsets times n to x,y,z. Returns this if n==0. Basis for up/down/north/south/east/west helpers.
methods.name: offset
methods.purpose: Returns pos shifted n blocks along EnumFacing.

methods.detail: Returns this if delta is zero to avoid allocation. Double variant floors via Vec3i. Used for movement and collision stepping.
methods.name: add
methods.purpose: Adds int, double, or Vec3i delta returning new pos.

methods.detail: Formula (y1*z2-z1*y2, z1*x2-x1*z2, x1*y2-y1*x2). Used for orientation and normal math. Returns new instance.
methods.name: crossProduct
methods.purpose: Computes vector cross product as BlockPos.

methods.detail: Normalizes min/max corners. Guava AbstractIterator stepping x then y then z. Used for block scans and multi-block change.
methods.name: getAllInBox
methods.purpose: Iterates all immutable positions in cuboid.

methods.detail: Avoids allocation by mutating x,y,z fields. Same x-y-z carry order. Preferred for tight collision and lighting loops.
methods.name: getAllInBoxMutable
methods.purpose: Same cuboid scan reusing one MutableBlockPos.

methods.detail: Sets x,y,z fields and returns this. Overrides immutable getters to read mutable fields. Used in iteration hot paths.
methods.name: MutableBlockPos.set
methods.purpose: Mutates reusable pos without allocation.

BlockPos.overview: Immutable integer position extending Vec3i in net.minecraft.util. Created from entities, Vec3, and packet longs. Matters for packets because block dig, place, and change packets carry it as a single packed long.

internal_fields.name: directionMaps
internal_fields.role: Per-direction BiMap of id to packet class

internal_fields.name: STATES_BY_ID
internal_fields.role: Array lookup from protocol id to state

internal_fields.name: STATES_BY_CLASS
internal_fields.role: Reverse map from packet class to state

methods.detail: Creates Guava HashBiMap per EnumPacketDirection if absent. Throws if class already registered. Id equals bimap.size() before put.
methods.name: registerPacket
methods.purpose: Assigns next sequential id to packet class per direction.

methods.detail: Inverts direction BiMap and gets class key. Used when writing packet header VarInt. Returns Integer id or null.
methods.name: getPacketId
methods.purpose: Looks up outbound packet id for encoder.

methods.detail: Looks up class by id then calls newInstance. Returns null if unknown id. Decoder drops or disconnects on null.
methods.name: getPacket
methods.purpose: Instantiates inbound packet by numeric id.

methods.detail: Bounds-checks against -1 to 2 then indexes STATES_BY_ID. C00Handshake carries this id. Switches pipeline state.
methods.name: getById
methods.purpose: Resolves protocol state from handshake nextState.

methods.detail: Looks up STATES_BY_CLASS map keyed by class. Populated in static init. Used for validation and logging.
methods.name: getFromPacket
methods.purpose: Finds owning state for a packet instance.

methods.detail: Clientbound S00-S49 plus S14/S19 sub-ids; serverbound C00-C19 plus C03/C06 splits. Order defines 1.8.9 wire ids, e.g. S08 pos-look.
methods.name: PLAY-init
methods.purpose: Registers all play-state clientbound and serverbound packets.

EnumConnectionState.overview: Protocol-state enum mapping packet ids to classes per direction. States HANDSHAKING, PLAY, LOGIN, STATUS with ids -1,0,2,1. Central registry consulted by NetworkManager to instantiate and route every packet.

packet_usage.trigger: Client connects, carries nextState to select PLAY/LOGIN/STATUS
Server teleports or corrects player, client confirms with C03
Client movement tick, server validates position and look
Login success transitions LOGIN to PLAY state

internal_fields.name: multiplyDeBruijnBitPosition
internal_fields.role: 32-entry log2 lookup for De Bruijn index

methods.detail: Index=(int)(value*10430.378)&65535 where constant is 65536/2pi. Table precomputed in static block. Used for yaw, head look, and motion vectors.
methods.name: sin
methods.purpose: Fast sine via 65536-entry lookup table.

methods.detail: Index adds 16384 (pi/2) before mask. Avoids second table. Same 2pi/65536 step resolution as sin.
methods.name: cos
methods.purpose: Fast cosine via sine table with quarter-period offset.

methods.detail: Casts to int then subtracts 1 if value below cast. Handles negatives correctly unlike truncation. Basis for BlockPos from entity pos.
methods.name: floor_double
methods.purpose: Greatest integer <= double for block coords.

methods.detail: Ternary num<min?min:num>max?max:num. Timer uses it to clamp frame delta 0-1. Also used for health, progress, and deltas.
methods.name: clamp_double
methods.purpose: Constrains value to [min,max] range.

methods.detail: Applies %360 then subtracts 360 if >=180, adds if <-180. Double variant identical. Critical for S08/C03 look deltas.
methods.name: wrapAngleTo180_float
methods.purpose: Normalizes yaw to [-180,180) degrees.

methods.detail: Returns (int)(value>=0?value:-value+1). Used for entity size and bounding computations. Avoids float rounding edge cases.
methods.name: func_154353_e
methods.purpose: Ceil of absolute value for packet size math.

methods.detail: Formula p<0?-((-p-1)/size)-1:p/size. Ensures -1..-16 maps to chunk -1. Used for chunk lookup from block pos.
methods.name: bucketInt
methods.purpose: Floor division bucket for negative chunk coords.

methods.detail: Rounds up to power of two then De Bruijn multiply 125613361>>27 lookup. Subtracts 1 if not power of two. BlockPos uses it for NUM_X_BITS.
methods.name: calculateLogBaseTwo
methods.purpose: Floor log2 via De Bruijn sequence for bit packing.

MathHelper.overview: Static math utility in net.minecraft.util used by entities, rendering, and packets. Provides sin table, floor, clamp, angle wrap, and noise helpers. Matters for packets because movement yaw/pitch, positions, and chunk math all normalize through it.

internal_fields.name: buf
internal_fields.role: Wrapped Netty ByteBuf delegating all I/O

internal_fields.name: getVarIntSize
internal_fields.role: Static byte-count predictor for VarInt values

internal_fields.name: readUuid
internal_fields.role: Two-long UUID codec for player ids

methods.detail: Accumulates 7 bits per byte while high bit set. Throws if more than 5 bytes. Basis for packet framing and array/string lengths.
methods.name: readVarIntFromBuffer
methods.purpose: Reads 1-5 byte VarInt packet id and lengths.

methods.detail: While (input&-128)!=0 writes (input&127|128) then >>>=7. Single byte fast path for values under 128 like most packet ids.
methods.name: writeVarIntToBuffer
methods.purpose: Writes minimal-byte VarInt encoding.

methods.detail: VarInt length must be <=maxLength*4 and >=0. Decodes UTF-8 then enforces char length <=maxLength. Throws DecoderException otherwise.
methods.name: readStringFromBuffer
methods.purpose: Reads UTF-8 string with length and content checks.

methods.detail: Encodes via Charsets.UTF_8, throws EncoderException if >32767 bytes. Prefixes VarInt length then raw bytes. Returns this.
methods.name: writeString
methods.purpose: Writes UTF-8 string with 32767 byte cap.

methods.detail: Calls readLong then BlockPos.fromLong. Used by block change, dig, place, sign, and tile entity packets. 26/12/26 bit split.
methods.name: readBlockPos
methods.purpose: Reads packed 8-byte block coordinate.

methods.detail: Calls writeLong(pos.toLong()). Canonical encoding for all block-position fields. 8 bytes versus 12 for raw ints.
methods.name: writeBlockPos
methods.purpose: Writes BlockPos as single long.

methods.detail: Short id -1 means null. Otherwise byte count plus short meta, then NBT compound. Used by window, creative, and equipment packets.
methods.name: readItemStackFromBuffer
methods.purpose: Reads item id, count, meta, and NBT.

methods.detail: Peeks first byte; 0 means null. Else resets readerIndex and gunzips via CompressedStreamTools with 2MB NBTSizeTracker cap.
methods.name: readNBTTagCompoundFromBuffer
methods.purpose: Reads possibly-null compressed NBT tag.

PacketBuffer.overview: Netty ByteBuf wrapper in net.minecraft.network adding Minecraft codecs. Used by every Packet readPacket and writePacket method. Matters because VarInt, strings, BlockPos, ItemStack, NBT, UUID, and chat all funnel through it.

internal_fields.name: ticksPerSecond
internal_fields.role: Target ticks per second, 20 in vanilla

internal_fields.name: elapsedTicks
internal_fields.role: Whole ticks to run this frame, capped at 10

internal_fields.name: timeSyncAdjustment
internal_fields.role: Drift correction ratio for hi-res clock

methods.detail: Stores ticksPerSecond. Seeds lastSyncSysClock via Minecraft.getSystemTime and lastSyncHRClock via nanoTime ms. Initializes timeSyncAdjustment to 1.0.
methods.name: Timer
methods.purpose: Constructs timer with target ticks-per-second, default 20.

methods.detail: Computes sysClock delta j and hrClock seconds d0. If j outside 0-1000ms resets lastHRTime. Otherwise accumulates counter for drift correction.
methods.name: updateTimer
methods.purpose: Advances tick counters from wall-clock delta each frame.

methods.detail: When counter exceeds 1000ms computes ratio counter/(k-lastSyncHRClock). Blends into timeSyncAdjustment with 0.2 factor. Resets counter and anchor.
methods.name: updateTimer#sync-adjust
methods.purpose: Calibrates hi-res clock against system clock once per second.

methods.detail: Formula d2=(d0-lastHRTime)*timeSyncAdjustment. Clamps d2 to 0-1 via MathHelper. Adds d2*timerSpeed*ticksPerSecond to elapsedPartialTicks.
methods.name: updateTimer#accumulate
methods.purpose: Converts seconds delta into fractional tick progress.

methods.detail: elapsedTicks=(int)elapsedPartialTicks then subtracts back fractional remainder. Caps elapsedTicks at 10. Prevents huge catch-up bursts after lag.
methods.name: updateTimer#cap-ticks
methods.purpose: Extracts whole ticks and enforces spiral-of-death cap.

methods.detail: Public float field set equal to elapsedPartialTicks each update. Frozen when paused to avoid jitter. Read by entity rendering and camera code.
methods.name: renderPartialTicks
methods.purpose: Exposes interpolation factor for render and movement smoothing.

Timer.overview: Client tick-rate driver in net.minecraft.util. Owned by Minecraft game loop, called each frame via updateTimer. Converts wall-clock delta into elapsedTicks and renderPartialTicks. Matters for movement because it bounds ticks to 10 and scales by timerSpeed.
